question: What request is made to the deity after entrusting the four aims within her?
premises: The fourfold aim is placed in the deity
The deity is addressed as giver of success
A repeated imperative requests her to be so
inference: Having placed the fourfold aim in you, the practitioner asks the deity to be the giver of success.
uncertainties: The sandhi-fused tokens contain multiple grammatical elements within single surfaces.
plain_english: The fourfold aim is placed in you; therefore be, be the giver of success to me.
